name: Lew'el
description: Lew'el, which meant deluge, was an aquatic planet located in the Wild Space of the galaxy. Originally settled by humans a long time ago, Lew'el remained a largely forgotten world by those who craved power. Humans native to Lew'el were called Lew'elans.
